name: Recall Cards
description: Spaced-repetition flashcards for interview prep and learning. Pick a topic, flip cards, self-rate — the SM-2 algorithm decides when each card returns based on how well you knew it.
shortDescription: Spaced-repetition flashcards. SM-2 decides what comes back.

name: Brain Dump
description: Empty your head in seconds. Type whatever is cluttering your mind — worries, ideas, to-dos, random thoughts — and let it go. Clears mental noise so you can focus on what matters.
shortDescription: Empty your head in seconds. Clear mental clutter, then focus.

name: Pomodoro
description: Work and study timer with a twist: draw a mindmap of your session goals and convert nodes directly into timed tasks. Focus intervals, break reminders, and a visual record of what you shipped.
shortDescription: Work timer with mindmap — convert goals into timed tasks.

name: Sticky Notes
description: Colourful sticky notes that live in your browser. Pin thoughts, links, or reminders on a freeform canvas. Pairs with Brain Dump — promote a dump entry to a sticky in one click.
shortDescription: Colourful sticky notes on a freeform canvas.
